name: Pommerman
description: We present Pommerman, a multi-agent environment based on the classic console game Bomberman. Pommerman consists of a set of scenarios, each having at least four players and containing both cooperative and competitive aspects. We believe that success in Pommerman will require a diverse set of tools and methods, including planning, opponent/teammate modeling, game theory, and communication, and consequently can serve well as a multi-agent benchmark. To date, we have already hosted one competition, and our next one will be featured in the NIPS 2018 competition track.
reputation: A well-known multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmark from the Bomberman-style environment, especially used in competition settings and research on coordination and adversarial play.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance is highly sensitive to environment setup, self-play training, and competition rules, and results are not directly comparable across scenario variants.
